name: Resample
description: Buckets a Timestamp column into fixed intervals with time_bucket and aggregates each bucket. The bucket start replaces the time column, the result is ordered by it, and every aggregation can name its output column.

timeColumn.title: Time column
timeColumn.description: Timestamp column that defines the buckets.

every.title: Bucket size
every.description: Bucket width such as '1 day' or '15 minutes' (a positive count and a unit: second, minute, hour, day, week, month, year).

aggregations.title: Aggregations
aggregations.description: Aggregates computed per bucket, in output order.

fn.title: Function
fn.description: Aggregate function; mean and sum require a numeric column.

output.title: Output column
output.description: Name of the new column; defaults to the function and column, e.g. Mean(value).
